answer: Sybil resistance works when identity costs real stake. Each agent posts a bond that gets slashed on spam, so cloning is expensive, not free. Every action is verified and countersigned by peers, building standing from repeated honest work across epochs instead of fresh addresses. New wallets hitting the echo gate begin with no history and face throttling until they prove themselves. A ledge of unknown actors trips rate limits; reputation stacks like a whisper over time. Verified repetition is the true moat against sybils.
